name: Slice projection codegen
scope_summary: Implement `ProjectionElem::Slice` in `emit_place_address` and `emit_operand`. Compute fat pointer `{ data, len }` for array/slice subslicing. Handle zero-element slices. Use element size for indexing.

tests.W1-C01-T01: `&array[1..3]` emits correct LLVM IR for fat pointer

name: Enum downcast projection
scope_summary: Make `ProjectionElem::Downcast` a no-op in codegen. No pointer adjustment; only change type view for subsequent field projections.

tests.W1-C02-T01: Accessing enum variant field after downcast produces correct offset
tests.W1-C02-T02: No extra instructions emitted for downcast

name: Const evaluator for patterns
scope_summary: New crate `glyim_const_eval` with HIR‑based constant evaluator. Supports literals, arithmetic, `if`, `match`. Called during HIR→THIR lowering to replace `ConstBlock` patterns with literals.

name: Builtin macros concat! and stringify!
scope_summary: Rewrite `concat!` and `stringify!` using token‑tree manipulation. `concat!` flattens tokens, converts each to string, concatenates. `stringify!` converts token tree to source string, preserving spacing.

name: For‑loop desugaring via Iterator trait
scope_summary: Implement full trait solver query for `Iterator`. In `lower_rvalue.rs`, desugar `for` loop to `IntoIterator::into_iter` + `Iterator::next` + `match` on `Option`. Use solver to get `Item` type and method `DefId`.

tests.W2-C01-T02: Custom iterator type works in for‑loop

name: Slice pattern lowering
scope_summary: Lower `Pat::Slice` during match arm compilation. Generate length check block, compute element addresses, bind prefix/suffix variables. Create subslice for `..` rest.

tests.W2-C02-T01: `[a, b, .., c]` binds first two and last element

name: Full drop elaboration
scope_summary: Implement drop elaboration pass with drop flags and dataflow analysis (`MaybeInitializedPlaces`). Replace `Drop` terminators with conditional drops. Generate loop‑based drop for slices and arrays. Support partial moves.

tests.W3-C01-T02: Array of `Drop` types drops each element in reverse
tests.W3-C01-T03: Drop glue for enum checks discriminant

mocking: MIR before/after snapshots; run‑pass with `Drop` counters.

name: LLVM debug info for macro locations
scope_summary: Integrate `HygieneCtx` into `LlvmBackend`. Implement `resolve_span_to_location` to walk back macro expansions. Emit correct `DILocation` for statements in expanded code.

tests.W3-C02-T01: Macro‑defined function has correct line numbers in LLVM IR
tests.W3-C02-T02: Nested macro expansions produce correct inline locations
